t0: Holds the rollout where it is: no new step starts until it is resumed.
t1: Lets a rollout a person paused carry on.
t2: Replaces the workload's pods one by one (a rolling restart): the service keeps answering.
t3: Changes the number of replicas, within what this Airfield allows.
t5: Abort and return to the last good release
t6: Protected {environment}: no approval first, an approver reviews it afterwards.
t7: The rollout is aborted first, so all traffic goes back to the stable version.
t8: through Git, as Return to base does. A database or configuration is never restored.
